newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INTERVIEW-Capral sees firm aluminum price.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-Capral sees firm aluminum price.

text.p: Capral Aluminium Ltd managing director Ian Edwards said on Tuesday he expected aluminium prices to remain higher in the second half of calendar 1997, which would be reflected in Capral's December half result.

"It (aluminium) is running at a higher level than the first half of the year, so we would be expecting it to stay at about that level for the second half of the year. It should help underpin our second half performance," Edwards told Reuters.
Earlier Capral reported a 0.8 percent fall in net profit to A$17.795 million for the six months ended June 30, 1997.
